Fixed `week_key` in `dates.py:10` so weeks run Sunday through Saturday.

**The bug.** The function used Python's ISO calendar, where weeks start on Monday. That put Sunday into the previous week and left Saturday as the second-to-last day instead of the last.

**The fix.** The date is shifted forward one day before taking the ISO week. Sunday then lands on the Monday that starts an ISO week, and Saturday lands on the Sunday that ends the same ISO week. The key format is unchanged, and nothing else in the project calls `week_key`.

**Verified.** Sunday 2026-10-04 through Saturday 2026-10-10 all produce the same key, while the Saturday before and the Sunday after fall into different weeks. The same holds across the year boundary for Sunday 2026-12-27 through Saturday 2027-01-02. The existing test suite passes with zero failures.
